inference.joint_resampling: One common Rademacher sign per calendar block across every leaf. Null-center per-leaf supported block means. No default every-third-sign or4of6 breadth.
inference.studentization: Mean of equal supported block means / sample SD of those means divided by sqrt(n); recompute centered bootstrap variance in every draw.
inference.support: At least 7 valid days/block, 12 supported blocks/leaf, and 42 observed days in each fixed70-day third; unsupported/degenerate leaf fails closed. Keep original calendar/masks. No imputation to zero observations and no clock compression.
